description: Sets the film's background music, composed new for it (original, instrumental, never a copy). mode "score": music only where it serves the story, in parts on the film's seconds, each with a role (silent, soft, bed, build, peak, outro): e.g. soft under the setup, build into the reveal, peak on it, silent under steps the viewer must follow, outro on the ending; this is how premium ads use music. mode "bed": one piece under it all, composed for the film's length. Score and bed are priced by the started minute of film. mode "loop": one steady, loopable piece that plays round under the film: one flat price whatever the length (about a third of a one-minute score), saved in the person's music for their other videos; no parts, no beat grid to cut on. mode "own": one of the person's own tracks (they upload them in the studio's Sound & music tab and must own the rights; call with no track to list them). mode "same_as": the music another of their videos plays (from: its id), e.g. the episode before in a series. mode "none": no music. An ILLUSTRATED STORY plays one piece under it all: own, same_as, loop or none (never score or bed); a story made for a series already keeps the music of the episode before. You pick the kind for this film yourself and name it in one line with your other picks; they can change it, and when they ask, give the kinds with their plus and minus. Composing uses the person's credits within the estimate you said: the brief's Make it is the OK in make it for me; in choose each step, picking the voice is (it covers the music you named); new music after the MP4 is asked again first; changing only how loud a part plays (a part's level 0…1.5, or the level) composes nothing and is instant. The host plays it, ducked under the voice: never play music from the film.

from.description: For same_as: the id of another of their videos whose music this one plays

level.description: How present overall: subtle, medium (default), present

mode.description: The kind of music, as the description says: score, bed, loop, own, same_as or none

prompt.description: Instruments, tempo and feeling in plain words (never a song, film or artist name); kept from before when left out

sections.description: For score: the parts in film seconds ({from, to, role, styles?, level?}); gaps play as soft; a part shorter than 3 s is composed with its neighbour but still plays at its own level

track.description: For own: the track's id or name, from the list mode own gives without it

name: music
title: Music for the film
